body:
Upstream issue: https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/issues/34857

Mirror issue: https://github.com/amdpilot-org/sglang/issues/1678

Candidate PR: https://github.com/amdpilot-org/sglang/pull/1527 at exact commit `034ffd7a3995b4cd941f38ee5398250be938b599`

Independent review PR: https://github.com/amdpilot-org/sglang/pull/1643

## What changed

- Reproduced the review counterexample independently on the assigned MI350X/gfx950: the candidate returned fp32 tensors, but every value at the production, fallback, and skinny test shapes was exactly bf16-representable.
- Preserved the candidate's valid fp32 output contract and the prepared base's existing GLM-5.2 correction-bias fixes.
- Replaced the aiter cast-after-bf16 router path with ROCm `torch.mm(..., out_dtype=torch.float32)`, which retains fp32 logit precision for bf16 inputs and weights.
- Strengthened the GPU regression to check numerical content against an independent fp32-input `F.linear` reference, not only dtype, shape, and finiteness.

## Failing before / passing after

```bash
HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 AITER_CACHE_DIR=/tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-2226cedf1c06/cache \
  /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-2226cedf1c06/venv/bin/python -m pytest -q \
  test/registered/unit/layers/test_aiter_router_gemm_dtype.py
```

At the exact candidate behavior: three subtests failed because no output value carried precision beyond bf16. After this correction: `1 passed, 3 subtests passed`.

For `(M,K,N)=(8,7168,256)`, maximum error versus the independent fp32 reference is `7.15e-7`; rounding that reference through bf16 gives `7.79e-3`. All 2,048 corrected production-shape outputs contain precision beyond bf16.

The prepared base's existing correction-bias coverage also remains green:

```bash
/tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-2226cedf1c06/venv/bin/python -m pytest -q \
  test/registered/unit/models/test_glmmoedsa_correction_bias_fp32.py
```

Result: `9 passed`.

Raw failing-before/passing-after logs, GPU numerics, source paths, and structured result metadata are under `reports/j-2226cedf1c06/`.

## Limitations

No GLM-5.2 weights were available, so no full-model semantic or accuracy run was performed. Validation used one GPU only; no multi-GPU or multi-node claim is made. Performance against an available tuned aiter production entry was not evaluated; this correction bypasses aiter for router logits because the observed fallback computes in bf16 before widening. No native source changed, so no native rebuild was applicable.
